items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-20
items.q: This was music by Jay Castle and his orchestra. Well, Jay Castle opened the room, but he didn't stay very long.

ctx.x: Yeah. New Year's Eve opening, the blue room will be open from 10 until closing. This is an invitation. This was music by Jay Castle and his orchestra. Well, Jay Castle opened the room, but he didn't stay very long. How long did he stay? Long enough for Gordon Kirst to get the job.
How long was he around? About six months. He was around about six months.
